title: Regular sequences f_i x_i in a polynomial ring
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $f_1,\dots,f_r\in R$ elements which do not generate the unit ideal. The following are equivalent: (1) every permutation of $f_1,\dots,f_r$ is a regular sequence in $R$ [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]; (2) every subsequence $f_{i_1},\dots,f_{i_s}$ ($i_1<\dots<i_s$) is a regular sequence in $R$; (3) $f_1x_1,\dots,f_rx_r$ is a regular sequence in the polynomial ring $R[x_1,\dots,x_r]$.
